# V10.1 — Vote expectations, initial reviewed pilot

These nine values are the **mean expected national YES vote share**, not the percentage of respondents expecting acceptance. Manually read the original German second-wave SRG/gfs.bern reports, selecting all five and all four objects on two complete dates. The AHV section explicitly states a 52% mean expected YES for BOTH reform objects; both rows are recorded separately. The CO2 value is 49.8%, not 56% (the latter is the fraction expecting acceptance). All identities, wave numbers, source URLs, fieldwork midpoint, publication timestamps and dates must reconcile with the existing reviewed national poll table. The 2021 report was published June 2; the 2022 report September 14. Historical edition identity is not independently certified. Other pages were attempted via public web retrieval, with access failures and/or no matching text. Do not interpret missing values as 50%, derive means from majority probabilities, or select sources according to model errors.

Sources: [13 June 2021, wave 2](https://cockpit.gfsbern.ch/de/cockpit/srg_trend_032021-3-2/), [25 September 2022, wave 2](https://cockpit.gfsbern.ch/de/cockpit/srg_trend_25092022_w2/). Numeric facts only; no full articles copied.

This is an initial pilot, not complete historical coverage. The workflow separately inventories candidate passages on the reviewed 2021–2022 source URLs. Review candidates manually before adding them to the approved CSV and rerunning. The evaluation keeps all 66 objects, falling back to the frozen V8.1 forecast if no expectation is available.
